# Bathroom refit: our spec

Agreed between us on 4 March. The room is upstairs, 2.4 m by 1.9 m, and it has no window.

- Walk-in shower with a 900 x 900 mm tray and a fixed glass screen.
- Wall-hung toilet with a concealed cistern.
- Vanity unit, 600 mm wide, with a basin.
- Floor tiles 300 x 600 mm. Wall tiles to 1.2 m, and full height in the shower.
- Heated towel rail on the central heating.
- Budget: £6,500 all in.
- Work starts Monday 14 April.
